name: Rope Jumping Against the Clock
setup: Set the machine or the space up so you can move at a steady pace from the first minute.
cues: Count clean reps in the time; a rep that is not clean does not count.
Find a rhythm you can hold, then hold it.
Breathe out long every few strides or strokes.

faults.fix: Start at a pace you could talk at, then build.
Shorten the effort or slow the tempo until it stays smooth.
